rv.q: It’s a script that leaves no loose end – every single line has a worthwhile, deliciously funny purpose.
Matt DiCarlo’s production hums with comedic harmony.

cn.t: Critics praise this expertly timed farce full of bruised egos and disaster-upon-disaster chaos. The physical comedy and costumes particularly impress, though the humor works best for fans already familiar with Mischief's recurring gags.
